# The catalog of visual components

Every visual component a UI plugin renders, by the name a surface gives it. A component no enabled plugin renders is not in the catalog: an Appspec that names one is refused (see [UI Plugins](./index.mdx)).

| Plugin | Catalog | Enabled | Components |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `a2ui` (A2UI) | a2ui/v0.9 | yes | 24 |
| `mcp-apps` (MCP Apps) | — | no | none of its own yet |
| `mcp-ui` (MCP UI) | — | no | none of its own yet |

## A2UI (`a2ui`)

An agent describes an interface — a form, a table, a card — as a tree of components from a catalogue the host allows, and the host renders it; what the user does in it comes back to the agent as an action.

Catalog `a2ui/v0.9`: 18 standard components, whose properties are the protocol's own ([A2UI](https://a2ui.org/)), and 6 of Datalayer's own, whose properties are a JSON Schema the Canvas draws a properties form from.

| Id | Name | Category | Standard | What it is for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Text` | 🔤 Text | text | yes | Words on the page: a heading, a paragraph, the answer — plain or Markdown. |
| `Image` | 🖼️ Image | media | yes | A picture: a chart rendered elsewhere, a logo, a photo. |
| `Icon` | 🔣 Icon | media | yes | A small drawing that says what something is: a check, a warning, a link. |
| `Video` | 🎬 Video | media | yes | A film played in place. |
| `AudioPlayer` | 🔊 Audio | media | yes | A sound played in place: a recording, a summary read aloud. |
| `Row` | ➡️ Row | layout | yes | Children side by side, left to right. |
| `Column` | ⬇️ Column | layout | yes | Children one under the other. |
| `List` | 📃 List | layout | yes | Items one after the other, each drawn by the same children: results, alternatives, steps. |
| `Card` | 🗂️ Card | layout | yes | A framed group: what belongs together, set apart. |
| `Tabs` | 📑 Tabs | layout | yes | Several views of one place, one shown at a time. |
| `Divider` | ➖ Divider | layout | yes | A line between what comes before and after. |
| `Modal` | 🪟 Modal | layout | yes | A window over the page, opened by a trigger: details, a confirmation. |
| `Button` | 🔘 Button | action | yes | An action the person takes: send, run, approve. One filled button per screen. |
| `TextField` | ⌨️ Input | input | yes | A field the person types in: a word, a sentence, a number, a date. |
| `CheckBox` | ☑️ Checkbox | input | yes | Yes or no: an option on or off, a consent given. |
| `ChoicePicker` | 🔽 Select | input | yes | One choice, or several, among options the builder lists or the data gives. |
| `Slider` | 🎚️ Slider | input | yes | A number chosen along a range: a weight, a budget, a threshold. |
| `DateTimeInput` | 📅 Date and time | input | yes | A date, a time, or both, chosen from a calendar. |
| [`Table`](#table) | 📋 Table | data | no | Rows the application found or keeps, with the columns the builder chooses. |
| [`Chart`](#chart) | 📊 Chart | data | no | Numbers drawn: a bar, a line, a scatter of what the application measured. |
| [`FileUpload`](#fileupload) | 📎 File upload | input | no | A file the person gives the application: a document to read, a sheet to check. |
| [`Chat`](#chat) | 💬 Chat | conversation | no | The conversation with the application: its welcome, its starters, the composer. |
| [`Evidence`](#evidence) | 🔎 Evidence | data | no | What an answer rests on: the sources opened, the passages cited, each with its link. |
| [`Form`](#form) | 🧾 Form | input | no | Several fields asked at once, from a JSON Schema, checked as they are filled and again when they arrive (drawn with @datalayer/primer-rjsf). |

## A2UI: Datalayer's own components

### `Table`

📋 **Table** · data — Rows the application found or keeps, with the columns the builder chooses.

| Property | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | text | **Title**. What the table is, above it. | — |
| `columns` (required) | list of text (minItems 1) | **Columns**. The columns, in order. | — |
| `page_size` | integer (minimum 1, maximum 500) | **Rows per page**. How many rows show at once. | `20` |
| `selectable` | true or false | **Selectable**. A row may be chosen, and its choice sent. | `false` |

- **Shows**: `rows`.
- **Sends**: `selected`.
- **Events**: `select`.

Its properties, as a JSON Schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "columns"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "description": "What the table is, above it."
    },
    "columns": {
      "type": "array",
      "title": "Columns",
      "description": "The columns, in order.",
      "minItems": 1,
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "page_size": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Rows per page",
      "description": "How many rows show at once.",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 500,
      "default": 20
    },
    "selectable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Selectable",
      "description": "A row may be chosen, and its choice sent.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
```

An example, valid against it:

```yaml
title: Runs
columns:
- model
- pass rate
- cost
```

### `Chart`

📊 **Chart** · data — Numbers drawn: a bar, a line, a scatter of what the application measured.

| Property | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | text | **Title**. What the chart shows, above it. | — |
| `kind` (required) | `bar` \| `line` \| `scatter` \| `area` | **Kind**. How the numbers are drawn. | `"bar"` |
| `x` (required) | text | **Across**. The field along the bottom. | — |
| `y` (required) | text | **Up**. The field measured. | — |
| `series` | text | **Series**. A field whose values are drawn apart. | — |

- **Shows**: `points`.
- **Sends**: nothing.
- **Events**: nothing.

Its properties, as a JSON Schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "kind",
    "x",
    "y"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "description": "What the chart shows, above it."
    },
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Kind",
      "description": "How the numbers are drawn.",
      "enum": [
        "bar",
        "line",
        "scatter",
        "area"
      ],
      "default": "bar"
    },
    "x": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Across",
      "description": "The field along the bottom."
    },
    "y": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Up",
      "description": "The field measured."
    },
    "series": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Series",
      "description": "A field whose values are drawn apart."
    }
  }
}
```

An example, valid against it:

```yaml
kind: bar
x: model
y: pass rate
```

### `FileUpload`

📎 **File upload** · input — A file the person gives the application: a document to read, a sheet to check.

| Property | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` (required) | text | **Label**. What the person reads beside it. | — |
| `accept` | list of text | **Accepts**. The kinds of file it takes, by extension. | — |
| `multiple` | true or false | **Several**. More than one file at once. | `false` |
| `max_mb` | integer (minimum 1, maximum 500) | **Largest (MB)**. The largest file it takes. | `25` |

- **Shows**: nothing.
- **Sends**: `files`.
- **Events**: `upload`.

Its properties, as a JSON Schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "label"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "description": "What the person reads beside it."
    },
    "accept": {
      "type": "array",
      "title": "Accepts",
      "description": "The kinds of file it takes, by extension.",
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^\\.[a-z0-9]+$"
      }
    },
    "multiple": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Several",
      "description": "More than one file at once.",
      "default": false
    },
    "max_mb": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Largest (MB)",
      "description": "The largest file it takes.",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 500,
      "default": 25
    }
  }
}
```

An example, valid against it:

```yaml
label: The contract
accept:
- .pdf
- .docx
```

### `Chat`

💬 **Chat** · conversation — The conversation with the application: its welcome, its starters, the composer.

| Property | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `welcome` | text | **Welcome**. What it says before anyone writes. | — |
| `placeholder` | text | **Composer hint**. Shown in the composer while it is empty. | `"Ask anything"` |
| `starters` | list of text (maxItems 6) | **Starters**. Questions offered before the first message. | — |
| `show_tools` | true or false | **Shows its tools**. The tool calls are shown as they happen. | `true` |

- **Shows**: `messages`.
- **Sends**: `message`.
- **Events**: `send`.

Its properties, as a JSON Schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "welcome": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Welcome",
      "description": "What it says before anyone writes."
    },
    "placeholder": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Composer hint",
      "description": "Shown in the composer while it is empty.",
      "default": "Ask anything"
    },
    "starters": {
      "type": "array",
      "title": "Starters",
      "description": "Questions offered before the first message.",
      "maxItems": 6,
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "show_tools": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shows its tools",
      "description": "The tool calls are shown as they happen.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
```

An example, valid against it:

```yaml
welcome: Ask me to research anything.
starters:
- What changed in Python 3.13?
```

### `Evidence`

🔎 **Evidence** · data — What an answer rests on: the sources opened, the passages cited, each with its link.

| Property | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | text | **Title**. Above the sources. | `"Sources"` |
| `show_passages` | true or false | **Shows passages**. Each source with the passage cited from it. | `true` |
| `max_items` | integer (minimum 1, maximum 50) | **Most shown**. How many sources show before *more*. | `5` |

- **Shows**: `sources`.
- **Sends**: nothing.
- **Events**: `open`.

Its properties, as a JSON Schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "description": "Above the sources.",
      "default": "Sources"
    },
    "show_passages": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Shows passages",
      "description": "Each source with the passage cited from it.",
      "default": true
    },
    "max_items": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Most shown",
      "description": "How many sources show before *more*.",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 50,
      "default": 5
    }
  }
}
```

An example, valid against it:

```yaml
title: What this rests on
```

### `Form`

🧾 **Form** · input — Several fields asked at once, from a JSON Schema, checked as they are filled and again when they arrive (drawn with @datalayer/primer-rjsf).

| Property | Type | Meaning | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | text | **Title**. What the form is for, above it. | — |
| `schema` (required) | mapping | **Fields**. The JSON Schema of what is asked: its fields, their types, what is required. | — |
| `submit_label` | text | **Send button**. The words on its button. | `"Send"` |

- **Shows**: `values`.
- **Sends**: `values`.
- **Events**: `submit`.

Its properties, as a JSON Schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "schema"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Title",
      "description": "What the form is for, above it."
    },
    "schema": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Fields",
      "description": "The JSON Schema of what is asked: its fields, their types, what is required."
    },
    "submit_label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Send button",
      "description": "The words on its button.",
      "default": "Send"
    }
  }
}
```

An example, valid against it:

```yaml
title: The quote
schema:
  type: object
  required:
  - seats
  properties:
    seats:
      type: integer
      minimum: 1
      title: Seats
```
